description: RFC-0004 hashing reference vectors from an independent BLAKE3 (checked against 35 official vectors): H(domain, x) = BLAKE3.derive_key(context, x) for every domain on inputs of length 0, 1, 64 and 1025 filled with i mod 251; Merkle trees with canonical multiproofs; chained column digests with row block `block`; commitment_id from the TCE of a CommitmentDescriptor (RFC-0031)
